chapter.title: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY

heading: Thug.
text: Whoever, at any time after the passing of this Act, shall have been habitually associated with any other or others for the purpose of committing robbery or child-stealing by means of or accompanied with murder, is a thug.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
